options.title: Start the MAC preamble from the frame_src start
options.approach: Remove the fs_start register stage: tx_mac would take the preamble on frame_src's `start` instead of on `s_valid` one clock later. The preamble word does not depend on the frame data and word 0 depends only on the configuration, so tx_frame_src would present its first word directly. The mac_preamble and tx_encode registers, the CRC and the PCS are not changed.

gain.basis_note: The fs_start stage adds 1 clock, so at most 1 clock is saved. The gain can be 0 if the MAC's start decode then limits the clock: mac_preamble has 1.132 ns of setup slack.
gain.ceiling_basis: the clocks of the touched stages (1)

wall_minutes.basis: iterations x the recorded build time

cost.note: A small RTL change in two modules. Timing may need one or two rounds because the MAC stage has about 1.1 ns of slack.
cost.basis: iterations are the generator's estimate (a guess); wall time is those times the recorded Vivado run

options.title: Shorten the go-pulse crossing by removing the output register and merging edge detect
options.approach: In core, replace the xpm_cdc_pulse u_p_go chain (toggle flop, 2 synchroniser flops, edge detect, output register) with a form that keeps the toggle flop and the 2 synchroniser flops but derives the pulse from the last synchroniser flop and its previous value, with no separate output register. The quasi-static order bus crossing and the other crossings are not changed. The bus-settled check by frame_src (`stale` counter) has to be re-verified for the earlier pulse.

gain.basis_note: The crossing adds 4 clocks. The two synchroniser flops and the toggle flop stay, so only the edge-detect and output-register clocks (1 to 2) can go. The stage has 4.19 ns of slack, so timing is not the limit.
gain.ceiling_basis: the clocks of the touched stages (4)

wall_minutes.basis: iterations x the recorded build time

cost.note: The RTL change is small, but CDC reports, the `stale` check and a board run are needed.
cost.basis: iterations are the generator's estimate (a guess); wall time is those times the recorded Vivado run

options.title: Merge receive PCS gearbox extraction and descramble
options.approach: In rx_pcs, merge stage B (descramble and decode into x_d, x_c, x_v) with stage A (gearbox remainder and 66-bit block extraction) so the descrambled and decoded block is registered at the capture edge. The block-lock FSM, which reads the same block registers, is adapted to the merged register. The MAC, the decision logic and the crossing are not changed.

gain.basis_note: Stage B adds 1 clock, so at most 1 clock is saved. The stage notes say a 192-bit shifter plus a 64-bit XOR tree did not close at 161 MHz. With 2.215 ns and 1.544 ns of slack in the two stages, the merge may fail timing and save 0.
gain.ceiling_basis: the clocks of the touched stages (1)

wall_minutes.basis: iterations x the recorded build time

cost.note: If timing does not close after the merge, a partial merge or a restructure of the descrambler is needed.
cost.basis: iterations are the generator's estimate (a guess); wall time is those times the recorded Vivado run

options.title: All three latency changes together (whole design, cumulative)
options.approach: Apply the go-crossing shortening of O2 in core, the direct MAC start of O1 in tx_frame_src and tx_mac, and the rx_pcs stage merge of O3. On top of these, tx_path adjusts the order-bus sampling so frame_src still sees the bus settled when the earlier pulse arrives. The decision, the MAC registers, the TX PCS and the GT are not changed.

gain.basis_note: The ranges of O2 (1 to 2), O1 (0 to 1) and O3 (0 to 1) add to 1 to 4 clocks. This stays under the 6 clocks the three touched stages add (4 + 1 + 1). The low end is 1 because only the crossing change is likely to succeed if the others fail timing.
gain.ceiling_basis: the clocks of the touched stages (6)

wall_minutes.basis: iterations x the recorded build time

cost.note: Three changes in separate clock domains need their own timing and CDC rounds, plus a board run for the crossing.
cost.basis: iterations are the generator's estimate (a guess); wall time is those times the recorded Vivado run
